description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5920017278697 FUSEHOLDER,BLOCK: Line 0001 Qty 6 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0036 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
